who.source: WHO Child Growth Standards (2006/2007, Multicentre Growth Reference Study)

length_height_for_age.note: 0-24月为身长(卧位)，24月以上为身高(立位)

who_velocity.source: WHO Child Growth Standards: growth velocity based on weight, length and head circumference (2009)

china.source: WS/T 423-2022《7岁以下儿童生长标准》(国家卫生健康委员会 2022-09-19 发布, 2023-03-01 实施)

school_age.source: WS/T 456-2014《学龄儿童青少年营养不良筛查》+ WS/T 586-2018《学龄儿童青少年超重与肥胖筛查》
